32 English For Today
Lesson 8: Making a Class Committee
Keywords: forum, environment, fortnightly
A. Look at the two pictures. Then ask and answer questions:

Picture 1 Picture 2
1. What do you see in the picture?
2. What are the students doing in picture 1&2?
3. Do you do these things at home? If you don’t, who does?
B. Read the passage and answer the following questions:
Ms Subarna Saha, the class teacher, has just entered the classroom. She is now
talking to the students.
"Why is the classroom so dirty?" asks Ms. Saha."I know the school cleaner is
absent today. So what? Can't we ourselves keep our classroom clean?"says Ms
Saha. "Sorry teacher," Shafig, the class captain, says politely. "This is our
classroom. If you clean it, you will do physical work and feel good. Also it
is our responsibility to keep it clean and tidy", says Ms Saha.
"Okay, teacher," says Shafig, "We'll do it from now on."
"First, you can make a forum, and select a leader," the class teacher suggests.
"Then divide the cleaning activities among different groups." Ss
